reference.title: The screens of the app
reference.shortdesc: What each place in the list on the left shows, what the top of every screen holds, and what the lower places open.

section.title: The list on the left
section.p: A list of places runs down the left side of every screen. The place you are in is shaded. The first four places are above a line. Some show your whole tree. Others show one person, the person named in the chip that starts with . The chip shows once you open someone.

table.title: The main places and what they show

row.entry: The tree that is open, with a search box and the people you opened last.
The page of one person. On its side, the tablet shows the family tree beside it.
A drawing of the person with parents, partners and children.
The things that happened in that person's life.

section.note: If a page says Pick a person, it needs a person first. Choose , or search for someone and open them. shows how.

section.title: The top of every screen
section.p: A line at the top names the tree, then each page you came through to reach this one. Choose a name in that line to go back to that page. A back arrow at the top left takes you back one screen. Further right are three buttons.

ul.li: , with a magnifying glass, opens the search. It is not on , because has a search box of its own.
opens the sheet that adds something new. shows it.
, with a question mark, opens the guide to the screen you are on in the web browser of your tablet.

section.p: Every field of a form also has a small help button of its own.

This is the first screen. It names the tree that is open and counts its people, families and events. It has a search box, two buttons and, once you have opened people, the names you can go back to. shows how to search.

ul.li: and list the people you opened last.

section.p: This is one person's page: their names, their birth and death, their family and their photos. With the tablet on its side, the page is in two parts. The person is on the left, and their is on the right, with its own buttons. Drag the divider between the two parts to make one wider. shows how to open a person.

section.title: The other places in the list
section.p: Below the line, the list has seven more places. Each one opens a screen of its own.

section.p: The lists for the whole tree are empty until you add something with .

section.title: Your trees
section.p: Choose in the list. Each card is one family tree. It tells you how many people, families and events the tree holds, and which tree is . On its side, the tablet shows the cards side by side.
